# 1a Servers module, tables, templates core: contract

**Read first:** [build README → Phase 1](./README.md#phase-1-servers), [servers module](../modules/servers.md) (Locations and names, Templates, Manifest, Rendering), [template authoring](../processes/servers/template-authoring.md) (Validation, Rules), [VLESS XHTTP](../integrations/vless-xhttp.md), [ADR 0003](../adr/0003-proxier-rendered-stack-templates.md), [ADR 0009](../adr/0009-embedded-xray-core-no-docker-socket.md), [data model → Servers](../data-model.md#servers), the 0e **As built** notes. The seed's source: `~/projects/servers-templates/proxy/` (`compose.yaml`, `xray-config.json`, `nginx/default.conf.template`, `site/index.html`, `setup.sh`).

**Done when:** the `servers` module is enabled and migrates its whole Phase 1 schema; locations can be listed, added and edited; a manifest parses and is checked; a template version renders for a server context and for the sample context; every validator except `xray` (1c) runs; drafts can be saved, validated and published from Go (no editor UI yet); the seed template exists as version 1 after the first start and validates clean; every checklist line has its test.

No template pages in 1a except Locations. The Templates page arrives in 1b.

## Decisions

| Topic | Decision | Why |
|---|---|---|
| Manifest storage | The manifest is the file `manifest.yaml` among a draft's or version's files. No separate column. | One code path for files; export is the file list. |
| File rows | `content BLOB`, `path` relative, `/`-separated, no `..`, no leading `/`, no `./`, at most 255 bytes, `[A-Za-z0-9._/-]` only. Mode and validator come from the manifest, not the row. A file present in the tree but not in `files:` is an error ("not declared in the manifest"), except `manifest.yaml`. | Paths end up in shell commands and SFTP paths. |
| Draft concurrency | `servers_template_drafts.revision` starts at 1 and grows by 1 on every save. A save carries the revision it was based on; a mismatch is `templates.ErrDraftChanged` ("the draft changed since you opened it"). | Edge case "two tabs"; also the agent API's ETag (1h). |
| Validation result | `finding.Report{Findings []Finding}` with `ByPath()` (a `Path` of `""` is global), `Finding{Severity (error/warning), Check, Path, Line, Message}`. `Report.OK()` = no errors. The types live in the leaf package `servers/finding`, which `manifest`, `render` and `validate` all import: `manifest.Parse` and `render.Render` return findings while `validate` imports both, so any other home makes a cycle. Stored nowhere; recomputed on demand (validation is pure and fast). The publish event stores the warning count and messages. | |
| Rendering | `text/template` with `Option("missingkey=error")`, the function map below, a template name per file path so errors carry `path:line`. Output not HTML-escaped. Steps, endpoint fields, check args and `proxy_test.url` are rendered the same way, named `manifest.yaml#steps.install[2]` etc. | modules/servers.md#rendering. |
| Functions | `json` (marshal, no HTML escaping), `quote` (JSON string), `default`, `lower`, `upper`, `trim`, `urlquery`, `b64enc`, `sha256` (hex), `join`, `indent`. Nothing else (no `env`, no file access). | |
| Generated kinds | `uuid` (v4, lower case), `hex` (`length` chars, `crypto/rand`), `base64` (`bytes`, std encoding), `password` (`length`, `[A-Za-z0-9]`, rejection sampling). `prefix` is prepended. Length bounds: hex 4–128, password 8–128, base64 bytes 8–96. | |
| Sample context | Server `xx-1`, location `xx` "Sample" country `XX`, IP `192.0.2.10`, SSH port 22, both hostnames `xx-1.hosts.example.invalid`, params from `sample` then `default`, generated values freshly generated per validation, `.Clients` = `[{ID: <gen uuid or a fixed sample UUID>, Name: "shared"}]`, `.Template.Slug` and `.Template.Version` = the draft's slug and `0`. | template-authoring.md#validation. |
| `.Clients` | `[]Client{ID, Name}`; one entry `{ID: <endpoint credential>, Name: "shared"}` when the version has endpoints whose `credential` renders; for the seed, `ID = .Gen.client_uuid`. Built in two passes: endpoints' `credential` is rendered first (it may use `.Gen` and `.Params` only), then files. | ADR 0004. |
| nginx validator | `${VAR}` in `*.template` files is expanded from the `environment:` of the compose service that mounts the file (its `.env`-interpolated values); undefined variables are left as written. Then `ssl_certificate*` arguments are replaced with a throwaway path (no file is created: crossplane does not open certificates), hostnames of compose services in `*_pass` become `127.0.0.1`. Parsed with `crossplane.Parse` on an in-memory fs (`Open` hook), `ErrorOnUnknownDirectives: true`, `ParseComments: false`, context and argument-count checks on. Errors carry the file and line. The parse context comes from where the file ends up in the container: mounted at `/etc/nginx/nginx.conf` → main context; mounted under `/etc/nginx/templates/` or `/etc/nginx/conf.d/` → wrapped in `http { … }` (that is where the image's `nginx.conf` includes it); mounted elsewhere, or not mounted by any service → `nginx.conf` by name is main, anything else is wrapped in `http { … }`. Directives are matched with crossplane's default open-source nginx table (it knows `http2 on`, `ssl_reject_handshake`, `grpc_pass`). | User decision 2026-10-07: pure Go. |
| shell validator | `syntax.NewParser(syntax.Variant(syntax.LangBash)).Parse` on the rendered file; errors carry line and column. | Same. |
| compose validator | `github.com/compose-spec/compose-go/v2/loader` with the rendered `.env` (when the version has one at `dir` root) as the environment, `SkipResolveEnvironment`, no filesystem access outside the rendered set (relative bind paths are allowed and not checked). No services → error. Image without a tag or `:latest` → warning. | |
| json / yaml validators | `encoding/json` (`json.Valid` then decode for the offset → line), `goccy/go-yaml` (already in go.mod) for yaml. | |
| xray validator | Declared here; returns no findings until 1c wires `proxy.ValidateConfig`. The validator list must already accept `validate: xray`. | Keeps 1c from touching the schema. |
| Size | A file over 1 MiB → error on that file; a version over 10 MiB → global error. Counted on the raw (unrendered) files. | |
| Endpoint field checks | 1a checks only shape (a key, a known type, unique keys, `port` renders to 1–65535). The per-type checks (path with a leading `/`, etc.) arrive with `servers/endpoint` in 1c through the `validate.EndpointFields` hook. | |
| Step order | `steps.install` must start with `base-bootstrap` then `upload-files`, and `steps.redeploy` must start with `upload-files`; neither may appear anywhere else (nor in `uninstall`). The jobs run these two as their own job steps (with DNS and generated values in between during provisioning); the job's `install` step runs the rest of `steps.install`, and the deploy job's `redeploy` step runs the rest of `steps.redeploy`. Anything else → error on that step ("base-bootstrap must be the first install step"). | The manifest shows the whole sequence, but provisioning needs fixed points for DNS and secrets. |
| Steps naming files | A `run` step whose command's first word starts with `./` must name a file declared in `files:` ("./issue-cert.sh is not among the files"). Nothing else in the command is inspected. | Edge case "a step refers to a missing file". |
| Dropped endpoint key | Validation takes the previous version (if any) and warns for every endpoint key it had that the draft no longer has. | |
| Publishing | In one `Write`: re-read the draft at the given revision, run validation (validation itself runs **before** the transaction on the read draft; publish refuses if the revision changed meanwhile), insert version N+1 and its files, delete the draft, record `template.version_published{version, warnings}`. With errors nothing is written and `*templates.ValidationError{Report}` is returned. Warnings need `confirmWarnings=true`, else `*templates.WarningsError{Report}`. The first published version becomes the default automatically (records `template.default_version_changed{from: 0, to: 1}`). | |
| Slug | `^[a-z][a-z0-9-]{1,39}$`, unique, editable until the first publish. Name 1–80 chars. | |
| Seed | In `AfterMigrate` (the `module.Migrated` hook below) when `servers_templates` is empty: create template `vless-xhttp` "VLESS XHTTP behind nginx" and publish version 1 with notes "Converted from servers-templates/proxy", actor `system`, events recorded. Runs once; deleting the seed later does not recreate it (a row in `servers_meta` marks it). | template-authoring.md "created on first start". |
| Seed content | As [vless-xhttp.md#template-contents](../integrations/vless-xhttp.md#template-contents): `compose.yaml` **unchanged, images stay `:latest`** (user decision 2026-10-07: **Update images** pulls new versions); `xray-config.json` with `clients` from `.Clients` and `path` from `.Gen.xhttp_path`; `.env` rendered; `issue-cert.sh` from `setup.sh`'s `issue_certificate()`; the manifest of [modules/servers.md#manifest](../modules/servers.md#manifest). The seed therefore validates with exactly two `:latest` compose warnings (`certbot/certbot:latest`, `ghcr.io/xtls/xray-core:latest`; nginx is `nginx:stable-alpine`) and no error; the seeder publishes with `confirmWarnings = true`. | |
| Locations | Code `^[a-z]{2,5}$`, name 1–40 chars, country ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 upper case (validated against a built-in list that also gives the flag emoji and EN/RU country names). Code is immutable after creation; name and country editable. Delete only without servers (any lifecycle state). → `location.created` on create; edits record `location.changed{fields}`; delete records `location.deleted`. | servers.md. `location.changed`/`location.deleted` are new events (Doc changes). |
| Server numbers | `servers_locations.last_number`; reserving a name is `UPDATE … SET last_number = last_number + 1 RETURNING last_number` in the creating transaction. Never decremented. | "Never reused"; the single write connection makes it race-free. |
| Module hooks | `servers.Module` implements `Module`, `Initializer`, `EventDeclarer`, `SettingsDeclarer`, `MessagesDeclarer`, `RouteDeclarer`, `NavDeclarer`, `SubjectNamer`, `Searcher` in 1a. Later sub-phases add `JobDeclarer`, `SubscriberDeclarer`, `NotificationRenderer`, `DashboardDeclarer`. | |
| After-migrate work | New optional platform interface `module.Migrated`: `AfterMigrate(ctx) error`, called by `App.Migrate` after every module's migrations, in module order (the SSH key is created there for the platform). The seed uses it. | `Init` runs before the tables exist (0e As built). |
| Nav | Group **Servers**: Servers (`/servers`, `g s`, from 1d), Templates (`/templates`, `g t`, from 1b), Locations (`/locations`, from 1a). Each sub-phase adds its nav item together with its page, so the nav never links to a missing page. | |

Settings section `servers` (1a part; later sub-phases add fields to the same section):

| Key | Kind | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `servers.hostname_pattern` | string | `{location}-{number}.hosts.tikhonnnnn.com` | Must contain `{location}` and `{number}`, render to a valid DNS name for `xx-1`. |

## Tables

`internal/modules/servers/migrations/00001_servers.sql`. Every Phase 1 table; later sub-phases build on them. Times are `db.Time` text. Sealed columns name their AAD.

```sql
-- +goose Up

-- Run-once markers of the module (the seed).
CREATE TABLE servers_meta (
    key   TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    value TEXT NOT NULL
) STRICT;

CREATE TABLE servers_locations (
    id          INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    code        TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK (length(code) BETWEEN 2 AND 5),
    name        TEXT NOT NULL,
    country     TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(country) = 2),
    last_number INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,  -- the highest number ever used; never decreases
    created_at  TEXT NOT NULL
) STRICT;

CREATE TABLE servers_templates (
    id              INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    slug            TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    name            TEXT NOT NULL,
    description     TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    default_version INTEGER,                 -- a version number; NULL before the first publish
    archived_at     TEXT,
    created_at      TEXT NOT NULL
) STRICT;

-- At most one draft per template.
CREATE TABLE servers_template_drafts (
    template_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES servers_templates(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    based_on    INTEGER,                     -- version number; NULL for a new template
    revision    INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
    source      TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',  -- JSON: {"kind":"zip","name"} / {"kind":"git","url","ref","commit","path"} / {"kind":"version","version"}
    updated_at  TEXT NOT NULL,
    updated_by  TEXT NOT NULL                -- actor
) STRICT;

CREATE TABLE servers_draft_files (
    template_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES servers_template_drafts(template_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    path        TEXT NOT NULL,
    content     BLOB NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (template_id, path)
) STRICT;

CREATE TABLE servers_template_versions (
    id           INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    template_id  INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES servers_templates(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    number       INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (number >= 1),
    notes        TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    warnings     TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', -- JSON findings at publish
    source       TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', -- the draft's source, kept
    published_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    published_by TEXT NOT NULL,
    UNIQUE (template_id, number)
) STRICT;

CREATE TABLE servers_template_files (
    version_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES servers_template_versions(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    path       TEXT NOT NULL,
    content    BLOB NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (version_id, path)
) STRICT;

CREATE TABLE servers_servers (
    id                  INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    location_id         INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES servers_locations(id),
    number              INTEGER NOT NULL,
    name                TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    ip                  TEXT NOT NULL,
    ssh_port            INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 22,
    management_hostname TEXT NOT NULL,
    proxy_hostname      TEXT NOT NULL,
    state               TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (state IN ('provisioning','active','failed','retired')),
    template_id         INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES servers_templates(id),
    template_version    INTEGER NOT NULL,    -- the version in force (that of the current files: 1d, 1e)
    params              TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', -- non-secret parameters, JSON
    params_secret       BLOB,                -- vault "server:<id>:params": JSON of secret parameters
    notes               TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    -- provisioning
    provision_job_id    INTEGER,
    retire_job_id       INTEGER,             -- set when retirement starts ("retiring")
    failed_step         TEXT,
    failed_error        TEXT,
    -- health (active only)
    health              TEXT CHECK (health IN ('healthy','degraded','blocked','down','unknown','paused')),
    health_since        TEXT,
    health_reason       TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    health_detail       TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', -- JSON: the latest evaluation's per-check summary
    candidate           TEXT,                -- the last counted evaluation's candidate
    candidate_count     INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    counted_proxy_at    TEXT,                -- the proxy-test round the last counted evaluation used (1f flap rule)
    checks_paused_until TEXT,                -- '9999-12-31T00:00:00.000Z' = until resumed
    reminded_at         TEXT,                -- last server.still_unhealthy
    cert_warned         INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (cert_warned IN (0,1)), -- cert_expiring sent for this crossing
    disk_warned         INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (disk_warned IN (0,1)), -- disk_low sent for this crossing
    created_at          TEXT NOT NULL,
    activated_at        TEXT,
    retired_at          TEXT,
    UNIQUE (location_id, number),
    CHECK ((state = 'active') = (health IS NOT NULL))
) STRICT;

-- An IP belongs to at most one non-retired server.
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX servers_servers_live_ip ON servers_servers(ip) WHERE state <> 'retired';

CREATE TABLE servers_generated_values (
    server_id  INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES servers_servers(id),
    key        TEXT NOT NULL,
    value      BLOB NOT NULL,                -- vault "server:<id>:gen:<key>"
    pending    BLOB,                         -- a rotation's new value, same AAD, until committed
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    rotated_at TEXT,
    PRIMARY KEY (server_id, key)
) STRICT;

CREATE TABLE servers_endpoints (
    server_id    INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES servers_servers(id),
    key          TEXT NOT NULL,
    type         TEXT NOT NULL,
    host         TEXT NOT NULL,
    port         INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (port BETWEEN 1 AND 65535),
    secret       BLOB NOT NULL,              -- vault "server:<id>:endpoint:<key>": {"credential","params"}
    display_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    position     INTEGER NOT NULL,
    updated_at   TEXT NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (server_id, key)
) STRICT;

CREATE TABLE servers_deployments (
    id               INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    server_id        INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES servers_servers(id),
    kind             TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('provision','redeploy','upgrade','params','rotate','restore','restart','images','reboot')),
    template_version INTEGER NOT NULL,
    params           TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
    params_secret    BLOB,                   -- vault "deployment:<id>:params"
    job_id           INTEGER,
    state            TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (state IN ('running','succeeded','failed')),
    uploaded         INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (uploaded IN (0,1)), -- 1: it has servers_deployed_files (the "current files" rule)
    files_changed    INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    started_at       TEXT NOT NULL,
    finished_at      TEXT,
    error            TEXT
) STRICT;
CREATE INDEX servers_deployments_server ON servers_deployments(server_id, id);
CREATE INDEX servers_deployments_current ON servers_deployments(server_id, id) WHERE state = 'succeeded' AND uploaded = 1;

-- Files a deployment rendered. Only deployments that upload files have rows.
CREATE TABLE servers_deployed_files (
    deployment_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES servers_deployments(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    path          TEXT NOT NULL,
    mode          INTEGER NOT NULL,
    sha256        TEXT NOT NULL,
    content       BLOB NOT NULL,             -- vault "deployment:<id>:file:<path>"
    PRIMARY KEY (deployment_id, path)
) STRICT;

CREATE TABLE servers_dns_records (
    id         INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    server_id  INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES servers_servers(id),
    provider   TEXT NOT NULL,                -- 'cloudflare'
    zone_id    TEXT NOT NULL,
    zone       TEXT NOT NULL,
    name       TEXT NOT NULL,
    type       TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (type IN ('A')),
    content    TEXT NOT NULL,
    record_id  TEXT NOT NULL,
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    deleted_at TEXT,
    kept       TEXT                          -- why retirement kept it ("points elsewhere")
) STRICT;

CREATE TABLE servers_check_results (
    id           INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    server_id    INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES servers_servers(id),
    kind         TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('self','proxy','external')),
    endpoint_key TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',   -- proxy tests
    vantage      TEXT NOT NULL,              -- 'home' or a check-host node name
    at           TEXT NOT NULL,
    ok           INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (ok IN (0,1)),
    class        TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',   -- 'unreachable', 'stack-failed', 'host-key-changed', 'tcp-timeout', 'stalled', 'skipped', …
    inconclusive INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (inconclusive IN (0,1)),
    detail       TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'  -- JSON: timings, per-check items, the URL used, node answers
) STRICT;
CREATE INDEX servers_check_results_latest ON servers_check_results(server_id, kind, endpoint_key, vantage, at);
CREATE INDEX servers_check_results_at ON servers_check_results(at);

-- Home's reference check. Not per server.
CREATE TABLE servers_reference_results (
    id     INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    at     TEXT NOT NULL,
    result TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (result IN ('online','foreign-unreachable','offline')),
    detail TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'
) STRICT;
CREATE INDEX servers_reference_results_at ON servers_reference_results(at);

-- Home's current connectivity state. One row.
CREATE TABLE servers_home (
    id    INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK (id = 1),
    state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (state IN ('online','foreign-unreachable','offline')),
    since TEXT NOT NULL
) STRICT;

-- check-host.net nodes, refreshed daily.
CREATE TABLE servers_checkhost_nodes (
    name         TEXT PRIMARY KEY,           -- "ru1.node.check-host.net"
    country      TEXT NOT NULL,              -- ISO alpha-2
    city         TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    refreshed_at TEXT NOT NULL
) STRICT;

CREATE TABLE servers_metric_samples (
    server_id  INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES servers_servers(id),
    at         TEXT NOT NULL,
    load1      REAL NOT NULL,
    cpu_pct    REAL,                         -- NULL on the first sample after activation or reboot
    mem_used   INTEGER NOT NULL,
    mem_total  INTEGER NOT NULL,
    disk_used  INTEGER NOT NULL,
    disk_total INTEGER NOT NULL,
    rx_bytes   INTEGER,                      -- delta since the previous sample; NULL when unknown
    tx_bytes   INTEGER,
    cpu_busy   INTEGER NOT NULL,             -- raw /proc/stat counters for the next delta
    cpu_total  INTEGER NOT NULL,
    rx_counter INTEGER NOT NULL,
    tx_counter INTEGER NOT NULL,
    uptime     REAL NOT NULL,
    containers TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',   -- JSON: name, state, restarts
    PRIMARY KEY (server_id, at)
) STRICT;

CREATE TABLE servers_metric_hourly (
    server_id   INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES servers_servers(id),
    hour        TEXT NOT NULL,               -- start of the UTC hour
    samples     INTEGER NOT NULL,
    load1       REAL NOT NULL,
    cpu_pct     REAL,
    mem_used    INTEGER NOT NULL,
    mem_total   INTEGER NOT NULL,
    disk_used   INTEGER NOT NULL,
    disk_total  INTEGER NOT NULL,
    rx_bytes    INTEGER NOT NULL,            -- sums
    tx_bytes    INTEGER NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (server_id, hour)
) STRICT;

CREATE TABLE servers_rollouts (
    id           INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    template_id  INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES servers_templates(id),
    to_version   INTEGER NOT NULL,
    -- done: every item done or skipped; stopped: an item failed; cancelled: Stop rollout
    state        TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (state IN ('running','done','stopped','cancelled')),
    created_at   TEXT NOT NULL,
    created_by   TEXT NOT NULL,
    finished_at  TEXT                        -- set with server.rollout_finished; a cancelled rollout whose item still runs has none yet
) STRICT;

CREATE TABLE servers_rollout_items (
    rollout_id   INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES servers_rollouts(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    position     INTEGER NOT NULL,
    server_id    INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES servers_servers(id),
    from_version INTEGER NOT NULL,
    params       TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', -- values asked before the start
    state        TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (state IN ('waiting','running','done','failed','skipped')),
    job_id       INTEGER,
    error        TEXT,
    PRIMARY KEY (rollout_id, position)
) STRICT;

CREATE TABLE servers_agent_sessions (
    id            INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    template_id   INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES servers_templates(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    token_lookup  BLOB NOT NULL UNIQUE,      -- vault.Lookup(token)
    problem       TEXT NOT NULL,
    context       TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',-- JSON: what was included (report, job id, server ids, diff)
    agent         TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (agent IN ('claude-code','codex','other')),
    opened_at     TEXT NOT NULL,
    expires_at    TEXT NOT NULL,
    closed_at     TEXT,
    close_reason  TEXT CHECK (close_reason IN ('expired','revoked','published','discarded','replaced')),
    saves         INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    validations   INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    requests      INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    minute_start  TEXT,
    minute_count  INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
) STRICT;
-- One open session per template (its draft).
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX servers_agent_sessions_open ON servers_agent_sessions(template_id) WHERE closed_at IS NULL;

-- +goose Down
DROP TABLE servers_agent_sessions;
DROP TABLE servers_rollout_items;
DROP TABLE servers_rollouts;
DROP TABLE servers_metric_hourly;
DROP TABLE servers_metric_samples;
DROP TABLE servers_checkhost_nodes;
DROP TABLE servers_home;
DROP TABLE servers_reference_results;
DROP TABLE servers_check_results;
DROP TABLE servers_dns_records;
DROP TABLE servers_deployed_files;
DROP TABLE servers_deployments;
DROP TABLE servers_endpoints;
DROP TABLE servers_generated_values;
DROP TABLE servers_servers;
DROP TABLE servers_template_files;
DROP TABLE servers_template_versions;
DROP TABLE servers_draft_files;
DROP TABLE servers_template_drafts;
DROP TABLE servers_templates;
DROP TABLE servers_locations;
DROP TABLE servers_meta;
```

Job ids (`provision_job_id`, `job_id`) reference the platform's `jobs` table by value only (ADR 0002: no foreign keys across modules).

## Go signatures

### `servers/finding`

```go
type Severity string // "error" "warning"
type Finding struct {
	Severity Severity
	Check    string // "manifest" "parameters" "render" "endpoints" "xray" "compose" "nginx" "json" "yaml" "shell" "size"
	Path     string // "" for global
	Line     int    // 0 when unknown
	Message  string
}
type Report struct{ Findings []Finding }
func (r Report) OK() bool
func (r Report) Warnings() []Finding
func (r Report) ByPath() map[string][]Finding
```

### `servers/manifest`

```go
type Manifest struct {
	Name, Description string
	Requires   Requires
	Dir        string
	Ports      []Port               // "80/tcp"
	Parameters []Parameter
	Generated  []Generated
	Files      []File
	Steps      Steps
	Endpoints  []Endpoint
	Checks     []Check
	ProxyTest  *ProxyTest
}
type Requires struct{ OS, Arch []string } // "debian-12", "ubuntu-22.04"; "amd64", "arm64"
type Port struct{ Number int; Proto string }
type Parameter struct {
	Key, Label, Type, Help string // type: string email int bool choice text
	Required, Secret           bool
	Default, Sample            *string
	Options                    []string
}
type Generated struct {
	Key, Kind, Prefix string // kind: uuid hex base64 password
	Length, Bytes     int
	Rotate            bool
}
type File struct{ Path, Validate string; Mode fs.FileMode } // Mode default 0644
type Steps struct{ Install, Redeploy, Uninstall []Step }
type Step struct {
	Kind string         // base-bootstrap upload-files run compose-up compose-down wait-http
	Args map[string]any // the step's own fields: run/timeout, pull, volumes, url/resolve/status/timeout
	Pos  string         // "steps.install[2]" for messages
}
type Endpoint struct {
	Key, Type, Host, Port, Credential string // unrendered
	Params                            map[string]string
}
type Check struct{ Kind string; Args map[string]any; Pos string } // compose-running http-local cert-expiry disk-free run
type ProxyTest struct{ URL string }

// Parse reads manifest.yaml. Errors are findings with lines.
func Parse(b []byte) (*Manifest, []finding.Finding)
```

func (s *Service) ValidateDraft(ctx context.Context, templateID int64, by, actor string) (finding.Report, error)

`template.draft_saved{by, files}` and `template.draft_validated{by, errors, warnings}` are recorded by `SaveDraft` and `ValidateDraft` (events.md). A save that changes no file records nothing and keeps the revision.

## Routes

| Method, path | What |
|---|---|
| `GET /locations` | Table: flag, code, name, country, servers; **Add location** dialog; per row **Edit**, **Delete** (only with 0 servers) |
| `POST /locations` | create; field errors inline |
| `POST /locations/:id` | edit name, country |
| `POST /locations/:id/delete` | strength 1 |

Design: `RP-Locations`.

## Events

Declare every type of [events.md#servers](../events.md#servers) now, plus `location.changed{fields}`, `location.deleted`, `template.deleted`, `template.unarchived`, `server.notes_changed`, `server.rollout_started{servers, to_version}`, `server.rollout_finished{state, done, failed, not_started}` (all off). Each needs `event.<type>` EN/RU; the notifying ones need `notify.<type>` EN/RU (the platform's tests enforce both). Subjects: `location:<id>`, `template:<id>`, `server:<id>`; `health.*` have subject `home:1`.

`SubjectNamer`: `server` → name with flag, link `/servers/<id>`; `template` → name, `/templates/<id>`; `location` → code + name, `/locations`; `home` → "Home internet", `/`.

## Doc changes in the same commit

- `docs/adr/0009-…`: validators are pure Go (mvdan/sh, nginx-go-crossplane on the sandboxed copy); no `nginx`/`bash` in the image; the nginx check catches syntax, unknown directives, wrong contexts and argument counts, not what only a running nginx would.
- `docs/processes/servers/template-authoring.md#validation`: the `nginx` and `shell` rows say how they run now.
- `docs/events.md`: `location.changed`, `location.deleted`, `template.deleted`, `template.unarchived`, `server.notes_changed`, `server.rollout_started`, `server.rollout_finished`.
- `docs/modules/servers.md#manifest`: file path rules; the step-order rule (`install` starts with `base-bootstrap`, `upload-files`; `redeploy` starts with `upload-files`); a `run` of `./file` must name a declared file; the seed keeps `:latest` images and publishes with their two warnings.
- `docs/data-model.md#servers`: deployments carry `uploaded`; "current files" = the latest succeeded deployment that uploaded files.

Locations, in `store/locations_test.go` and `pages/locations_test.go`:

Manifest and rendering, in `manifest/` and `render/`:

- [ ] Unknown step kind, check kind, generated kind, validator, endpoint type; duplicate keys; bad port spec; relative or `/` dir → errors with lines — `manifest/check_test.go` `TestManifestSchemaErrors`
